name: アーカイブ会話への入口
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE real Lighthouse component LH03-0039「アーカイブ会話への入口」.
Image1 ORIGINAL is primary for archive-box glyph geometry, thin optical stroke, row proportions, quiet count and fine details. Image2 Japanese mock is secondary for exact copy and locked native typography/logical390x52. Image3 approved white/slate styling only.
Render ONE compact plain WHITE list entry. Left ORIGINAL outline archive box with its shallow projecting lid and small horizontal slot; preserve source anatomy/optical stroke, coherent slate#526173, about18x19logical at35,19. No arrow in box and no generic folder icon. Exact label「アーカイブ済み」Meiryo REGULAR14px/24px, tracking0, quiet slate/gray, atx84. Far right exact count「1」Meiryo REGULAR12px/16px, tracking0, gray#6E6E6E. Count is plain text, NOT a badge or unread state. Match source label/icon/count baseline and native compact spacing. No right chevron, colored icon backing, extra count or control.
Purewhite#FFFFFF canvas and row. A very fine neutral inset separator may follow the source list edge under text; no new enclosing card, heavy border, shadow, mint fill or green button.
Accent decision: original archive entry is neutral navigation with a total count, no selected/unread/primary-action state. Keep all regions quiet and coherent; no accent is needed.
One complete shortwide component centered prominently on landscape with modest margins, no clipping. Exclude search/filter/header, other chat rows, phone and footer. Preserve original fine glyph details and Japanese roles; static raster candidate.
reviewNotes: 原画像を保管箱の蓋/横スロットと静かな件数/配置の主参照、モックをアーカイブ済み/1とRegular14・12役割の副参照。出力を目視し全文と1・保管箱・白背景/中立スレート・余計なバッジ/矢印/ボタンなしを確認。未読や選択を示す行ではないため飾りの緑を省略。厳密字体/記号計測・実アーカイブ遷移・編集可能性・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
